messages:
jun: Heads-up — proposing API changes for the rerank endpoint: add a per-candidate `confidence` that is normalized across the returned set, plus an optional `explain_tokens` array when clients opt in. Need thoughts on format, billing, and rollout UX.

nina: high level — +1 for normalized confidence (makes downstream merges easier). worried about explain_tokens size & perf. how many tokens are we thinking?

alex: agree on normalized_confidence. For explains we should limit to max 3 tokens per candidate and mark it as opt-in. Also the backend should route explain requests to the explain-capable model variant.

jun: draft wire:
```json
{
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c1", "score": 3.1, "normalized_confidence": 0.78, "explain_tokens": ["why","relevance"]},
    {"id": "c2", "score": 2.7, "normalized_confidence": 0.22}
  ],
  "model": "rerank-v2"
}
```
this keeps old `score` for compatibility but adds the two new fields. thoughts on names? `normalized_confidence` vs `confidence_score`?

kevin: prefer `confidence` (shorter). but we need to be explicit it's normalized across the returned set. maybe `confidence_norm`. also: runtime implications — explain path uses a heavier model; we need a routing tag so console/metrics can show explain traffic and cost.

nina: +1 for `confidence_norm`. For quota/billing: explain_tokens should count against a new meter (explain_token_units) so we can show it in the console and optionally gate it per-tenant. Without this, some customers could blow up cost.

jun: good point. propose routing policy: if request includes `explain: true` -> route primary to `rerank-explain-v1` (higher cost) else `rerank-fast`. also allow `model_hint` to pin variants. fallback: if explain model is busy, either queue (bad) or degrade to explainless response with a `explain_unavailable` flag. prefer degrade + telemetry.

alex: UX in console — add a toggle on rollout page to enable explains in a canary ring (percentage). Console should surface expected cost uplift estimate before enabling. Also add a per-route metric: `explain_request_rate` and `avg_explain_tokens`.

kevin: implementation note: KV cache and batching behave differently for explain path (we need extra context), so batching windows might increase latency. Ops should be aware.

ops-bot: @channel deploy-checklist: ensure canary gating for explain model, add quota meter `explain_token_units`, add alert if explain_token_units > 2x baseline for 5m.

jun: question for API compatibility: do we want to keep `score` as raw model score (float) and add `confidence_norm` for UI decisions? or replace `score` entirely? replacement will break a lot of clients.

nina: keep `score` for now. add `confidence_norm` and document deprecation path. We can add server-side opt-in to emit only `confidence_norm` for new clients later.

alex: also add a small enum `explain_level`: `none|brief|detailed` instead of free-array size, map `brief`-> up to 1 token, `detailed`-> up to 3, helps in quota forecasting.

jun: action items: 1) wire PR with schema + examples (i'll open). 2) billing change ticket to add `explain_token_units` and per-tenant caps (kevin). 3) console UX mock for canary toggle + cost est (alex). 4) rollout playbook note: if explain requests spike, automatically flip explains off for non-paid tiers (nina).

kevin: +1. Also log an explicit routing tag `route_variant=explain` on traces for SLO debugging.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window requested for schema change: 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Confirmed by eng-platform.

jun: thanks everyone. i'll post the PR and link the console mock in this thread. if folks want different field names call it out in the PR review. :thumbsup:
